_help: One entry per project. The site is rebuilt from this file automatically on every push (see README). Fields: title, kind (small label), status (live | building | open | private | research), summary, impact (short bullets, optional), tags (technologies), filters (work, insurance, platform, security, learning), featured (true = also shown on Home), image (optional: assets/img/shots/<name>.webp, 640x360), caseStudy (optional page), links (label, url, icon: github | gitlab | external).

projects.title: Mustek East Africa platform
projects.summary: API, admin back-end, security dashboard and operations for a hardware distributor's website.
impact: 76 automated tests gate every deploy
Photos 77% lighter with a WebP pipeline
Consent-based personalisation, careers with CV upload
projects.imageAlt: The Mustek East Africa API documentation

projects.title: Stayvinci
projects.summary: Multi-tenant booking and storefront platform: API, guest PWA, business app, admin console and website in one monorepo.
impact: Tenant isolation with PostgreSQL row-level security
Four apps on one typed API
30 showcase stores for end-to-end demos

projects.title: AEGIS
projects.summary: An authorization-first, read-only assessment suite and money-integrity monitor: nothing runs outside a signed scope, and every action is logged.
impact: Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit log
Zero dependencies: pure Python standard library
projects.imageAlt: The AEGIS monitor dashboard, running on demo data

projects.title: Microinsurance Fraud Detection
projects.summary: Scores each insurance claim for fraud risk, explains why it was flagged, and gives analysts a dashboard to decide.
impact: Plugs in front of any claims system via REST
Explainable 0–1 risk score, not a black box

projects.title: InsureLog
projects.summary: A plug-and-play logging toolkit for insurance microservices: one dependency gives every Spring Boot service structured events.
impact: Automatic personal-data masking
Correlation IDs follow a customer across services
Central search, export and Grafana dashboard

projects.title: Policy follow-up mailer
projects.summary: Reads a client list (Excel or CSV) and sends each customer who started buying cover a personalised follow-up email.
impact: Skips bad, missing and duplicate rows, and says why
Everything configurable: nothing hard-coded

projects.title: Training Attendance System
projects.summary: Replaces a paper HR attendance form: employees sign in with a drawn signature, and finished sessions become branded PDFs on a helpdesk ticket.
impact: QR sign-in and an offline queue
PDF auto-attached to Freshservice
Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on

projects.title: Sales Returns Portal
projects.summary: Agents log up to 500 returned items; the system builds the Excel file, raises the Freshservice request and, on approval, creates Freshsales deals.
impact: Webhook plus a 5-minute safety sweep: no approval missed
Bulk upsert of one deal per item

projects.title: ARTEX defence map
projects.summary: A capability-by-capability breakdown of an open-source AI pentest platform, written to build detection and defence services for Kenyan banks.
impact: Ten segments, from recon to evidence reporting
Each with the defensive signals to watch for

projects.title: Customer Care Notification System
projects.summary: Reach customers by email and SMS: one-off messages, bulk campaigns from CSV lists, templates, and delivery tracking in one dashboard.

projects.title: BlueVision Realtors
projects.summary: Website for a Kenyan land specialist helping local buyers and Kenyans abroad find and buy verified land.

projects.title: Blokichain voting
projects.summary: Polls and votes live on an Ethereum smart contract so results can't be tampered with; an AI service flags unusual voting patterns.
